Name: Lumisteria Fashion Sense Clothes
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod adds several clothes (hats, shirts, dresses) for Fashion Sense.

Want a fresh look ? Get now several new outfits, including : flower dance theme, flower theme, witch hats, and new dresses matching polka dot hat, and mushroom hat.

Look at my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14970]Fashion Sense Hairstyles[/url] if you want even more options of customisation.

Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/157597893?tab=user+files]IcePrincess98[/url] for the conversion!
